problem_title: Sum up items in a Flex Card
caption:
Sum up items in a Flex Card

🔴 The Problem: I am quite newb when it comes to Omnistudio, just getting the grips of it. I have two flex cards, parent and child. The parent is just a collapsible toggle, and shows/hides child card. Child card is a bunch of quote line items and their prices. Ideally I'd like to show a total for all the items fetched in the quote line items.
